limitations: Only 4614d9ee -> 5d1712ec is included; the later parser classifier 5c1f436 and its measurements are excluded.
Alternate and primary are separate CI executions; comparisons are paired within each run, not pooled across runs.
Five AB/BA pairs per scenario on virtual GitHub runners, fixed within-sample workload order, no statistical significance or broad-workload claim.
The DSR barrier measures PTY processing and protocol RTT, not frame presentation, visual correctness or input-to-photon latency.
Rendering equivalence remains unverified, including composed graphemes and fallback glyph output.
This is not a competitor ranking or a result on an actual Omarchy/Hyprland machine, GPU or physical display.
Primary Unicode median increased 0.4849%, with a pairwise median change of only 0.0048% and two of five pairs slower. A separate macOS diagnostic is not a Linux result and is not incorporated here.
Binary hashes agree between CI reports and sha256sum records, but executable bytes were not uploaded and cannot be independently rehashed here.
Source refs were audited using the pinned workflow, Git inputs and build logs; the standalone runner records source_refs_verified_by_runner=false.
Local validation logs show successful release commands but do not embed command invocations or commits; their association was supplied by the operator.
The alternate report requests 10000 scrollback lines at top level but intentionally generates an effective history limit of zero; primary uses 10000.
